summary: Implemented compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults on ClientArgsCreator (botocore/args.py), added the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-Enum (botocore/regions.py), made the STS global-endpoint predicate accept an absent endpoint configuration, and added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins to tests/unit/test_args.py. tests/unit/test_args.py passes (58 tests), and tests/unit/test_regions.py plus tests/unit/test_client.py also pass (356 tests). Nothing is committed. Choices: absent SDK::Endpoint is returned as None so all eleven keys are present; the helper calls the bridge's private lookups as the spec requires; the auto and virtual addressing-style cases share one looping test. Not verified: black and flake8 are not installed in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand. Line lengths are within 79 columns for added lines; botocore/args.py line 315 (82 columns) predates this change.
